name: Visor
description:
Visor puts a notch below the top bar of GNOME Shell. It shows media, timers, downloads, calendar events, notifications and the sessions of T3 Code, and has a search field for commands, calculations and apps. Other extensions can add modules to it.

While enabled, Visor replaces the date menu in the top bar; disabling it brings the date menu back.

Clipboard: the result of a calculation or conversion is copied when you press Enter. Visor never reads the clipboard.
Network: daily exchange rates of the European Central Bank (can be turned off), cover pictures that media players name, and the T3 Code server you connect it to. No telemetry.
